name: Ahmad bin Hassan
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for dismantling and reassembling engines in his father's workshop. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, focusing on automotive design, before landing his first role as a junior engineer at a local touring car team. Over the years, he honed his skills, working his way up to become a race engineer known for his meticulous approach and ability to quickly diagnose and resolve complex mechanical issues under pressure.

Ahmad believes in fostering a collaborative environment, valuing input from all team members to achieve peak performance. He is especially adept at translating driver feedback into tangible adjustments to the car's setup. His experience extends across multiple racing disciplines, from touring cars to Formula racing, making him a versatile and valuable asset to any team. What sets Ahmad apart is his calm demeanor and his ability to mentor younger engineers, sharing his extensive knowledge and passion for motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ahmad is a stocky man with a friendly face and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking teh tarik from a specific mamak stall near the circuit before every race.
